description:
Dispatches any humanchrome browser-automation tool by name. Args validated server-side; on INVALID_ARGS the response carries `details.expected` (schema fragment) and `details.hint` (did-you-mean) so you can self-correct in one round-trip.
Call as `{ name: "<tool>", args: { ... }, raw?: boolean }`. Set `raw: true` to bypass the dispatcher's output-size cap.
Catalog:
- browser_alias_tab: Give an owned tab a human-friendly name so subsequent tool calls can target it without juggling raw tab ids.
- browser_claim_tab: Claim a tab as owned by the calling MCP client.
- browser_close_my_tabs: Close every tab currently owned by the calling MCP client.
- chrome_action_badge: Show a small badge on the extension icon — useful for live status during a long-running agent ("3 tabs", "ERR").
- chrome_alarms: Schedule one-shot or repeating callbacks via `chrome.alarms`.
- chrome_aria_snapshot: Playwright-style compact ARIA tree snapshot for token-efficient page reads.
- chrome_assert: Run one or more predicates against the page and return a structured pass/fail result.
- chrome_await_element: Wait for a DOM element to be present or absent on the page using a MutationObserver.
- chrome_basic_auth: Autoresponder for HTTP Basic / Digest auth prompts via CDP `Fetch.enable({handleAuthRequests:true})` + `Fetch.authRequired` + `Fetch.continueWithAuth`.
- chrome_block_or_redirect: Block or redirect URLs at the network layer via `chrome.declarativeNetRequest` *session* rules (no DNR ruleset reload, no manifest declaration — rules clear when Chrome restarts).
- chrome_bookmark_add: Add a new bookmark to Chrome
- chrome_bookmark_delete: Delete a bookmark from Chrome
- chrome_bookmark_search: Search Chrome bookmarks by title and URL
- chrome_bookmark_update: Update a Chrome bookmark: rename, change its URL, and/or move it to a different parent folder.
- chrome_clear_browsing_data: Wipe browsing-data stores via `chrome.browsingData.remove`.
- chrome_click_element: Click on an element in a web page.
- chrome_clipboard: Read and write the system clipboard via the offscreen document (the only DOM context where `navigator.clipboard.readText` / `writeText` works from a service-worker extension).
- chrome_close_tab: Close one or more browser tabs
- chrome_close_tabs_matching: Bulk close tabs matching one or more filters.
- chrome_computer: Use a mouse and keyboard to interact with a web browser, and take screenshots.
- chrome_console: Capture console output from a browser tab.
- chrome_console_clear: Reset the per-tab console buffer used by `chrome_console` (mode="buffer") and the `console_clean` predicate of `chrome_assert`.
- chrome_context_menu: Register transient right-click menu items via `chrome.contextMenus`.
- chrome_debug_dump: Return recent debug-log entries from the extension.
- chrome_dev_reload: Trigger `chrome.runtime.reload()` from the SW so unattended E2E runs (rebuild → reload → re-test) do not need an operator to click "reload" in chrome://extensions.
- chrome_download_cancel: Cancel an in-progress download by id via `chrome.downloads.cancel`.
- chrome_download_list: Enumerate downloads via `chrome.downloads.search`.
- chrome_drag_drop: Drag from one element to another by synthesizing the full HTML5 Drag-and-Drop + Pointer-Event chain.
- chrome_emulate: Per-tab CDP `Emulation.*` overrides (UA, locale, timezone, geolocation, device metrics, color-scheme, prefers-reduced-motion).
- chrome_fill_or_select: Fill or select a form element on a web page.
- chrome_focus: Focus an element programmatically by `selector` or `ref`.
- chrome_get_attributes: Read DOM attributes, properties, and computed CSS by selector or ref.
- chrome_get_cookies: Read browser cookies for a URL or domain.
- chrome_get_web_content: Fetch content from a web page (raw HTML, plain text, or reader-mode Markdown)
- chrome_get_windows_and_tabs: Get all currently open browser windows and tabs
- chrome_gif_recorder: Record browser tab activity as an animated GIF.
- chrome_handle_dialog: Handle JavaScript dialogs (alert/confirm/prompt) via CDP.
- chrome_handle_download: Wait for a browser download and return details (id, filename, url, state, size)
- chrome_har_export: Emit captured network data as standard HAR 1.2 JSON.
- chrome_history: Retrieve and search browsing history from Chrome
- chrome_history_delete: Delete entries from Chrome browsing history.
- chrome_hover: Programmatic mouse hover to trigger tooltips and dropdown menus.
- chrome_identity: OAuth2 + profile lookup via `chrome.identity`.
- chrome_idle: Query the user's idle state via `chrome.idle.queryState`.
- chrome_inject_script: Inject a user-specified content script into a webpage.
- chrome_intercept_response: Wait for the next network response on a tab whose URL matches the given pattern, then return the parsed JSON body (or raw body if non-JSON).
- chrome_javascript: Execute JavaScript code in a browser tab and return the result.
- chrome_keep_awake: Prevent the system from sleeping during long agent runs via `chrome.power.requestKeepAwake`.
- chrome_keyboard: Simulate keyboard input on a web page.
- chrome_list_frames: List the frames in a tab via chrome.webNavigation.getAllFrames.
- chrome_list_injected_scripts: List the user scripts currently injected via chrome_inject_script across all tabs.
- chrome_locator_handler: Auto-dismiss sticky overlays (cookie banners, GDPR consent modals, newsletter popups, "we use cookies" interstitials) that intercept clicks and break LLM flows.
- chrome_mock_response: Synthesize fake response bodies for matched URLs via CDP `Fetch.enable` + `Fetch.requestPaused` + `Fetch.fulfillRequest`.
- chrome_navigate: Navigate to a URL, refresh the current tab, or navigate browser history (back/forward)
- chrome_navigate_batch: Open many URLs at once and return their tabIds.
- chrome_network_capture: Unified network capture tool.
- chrome_network_emulate: Emulate network conditions on a tab via the Chrome DevTools Protocol (`Network.emulateNetworkConditions`).
- chrome_network_request: Send a network request from the browser with cookies and other browser context
- chrome_notifications: Push native OS notifications via `chrome.notifications`.
- chrome_owned_tabs: Return the tabs currently owned by the calling MCP client (or, for UI surfaces, the calling __ui:* lane).
- chrome_pace: Set a per-MCP-client pacing profile.
- chrome_pace_get: Read-only counterpart of `chrome_pace`.
- chrome_paste: Focus an element (by `selector` or `ref`) and paste text into it.
- chrome_performance_analyze_insight: Provides a lightweight summary of the last recorded trace.
- chrome_performance_start_trace: Starts a performance trace recording on the selected page.
- chrome_performance_stop_trace: Stops the active performance trace recording on the selected page.
- chrome_print_to_pdf: Save a tab as PDF via the Chrome DevTools Protocol (`Page.printToPDF`).
- chrome_proxy: Set / clear / inspect the proxy configuration via `chrome.proxy.settings`.
- chrome_queue_inspect: Diagnostic snapshot of per-tab serialization queues (IMP-0087).
- chrome_read_page: Get an accessibility tree representation of visible elements on the page.
- chrome_remove_cookie: Delete a single cookie by URL + name.
- chrome_remove_injected_script: Explicitly tear down a user script previously installed via `chrome_inject_script` on a tab.
- chrome_request_element_selection: Request the user to manually select one or more elements on the current page.
- chrome_runtime_info: Diagnostic.
- chrome_screenshot: [Prefer read_page over taking a screenshot and Prefer chrome_computer] Take a screenshot of the current page or a specific element.
- chrome_search_tabs_content: Semantic vector search across the content of currently open tabs.
- chrome_select_text: Select text inside an element.
- chrome_send_command_to_inject_script: If the script injected via chrome_inject_script listens for user-defined events, this tool dispatches those events to the injected script.
- chrome_sessions: Inspect and restore recently-closed tabs/windows via `chrome.sessions`.
- chrome_set_checked: Idempotent checkbox / radio state set.
- chrome_set_cookie: Set a single cookie.
- chrome_set_extra_http_headers: Inject extra HTTP headers on every request a tab makes, via CDP `Network.setExtraHTTPHeaders`.
- chrome_storage: Read, write, and clear a tab's `localStorage` or `sessionStorage`.
- chrome_switch_tab: Switch to a specific browser tab
- chrome_tab_groups: Manage Chrome tab groups (the colored, named clusters in the tab strip).
- chrome_tab_lifecycle: Memory-management and audio-state controls on tabs.
- chrome_type_into: Char-by-char keystroke typing into a focused selector with realistic per-key delay.
- chrome_upload_file: Upload files to web forms with file input elements using Chrome DevTools Protocol
- chrome_userscript: Unified userscript tool (create/list/get/enable/disable/update/remove/send_command/export).
- chrome_wait_for: Wait for one of: a DOM element to appear/disappear, the network to go idle, a specific response to fire, an arbitrary JS expression to return truthy, a page load state (Playwright-style `waitForLoadState`), or the tab URL to match a pattern (Playwright-style `waitForURL` — covers SPA pushState).
- chrome_wait_for_tab: Block until the given tab transitions to status:"complete".
- chrome_web_vitals: Live Core Web Vitals collector via `PerformanceObserver` in the page MAIN world.
- chrome_window: Manage Chrome browser windows.
- record_replay_flow_delete: Delete a recorded flow by ID.
- record_replay_flow_run: Run a recorded flow by ID.
- record_replay_list_published: List recorded flows that have been published as dynamic MCP tools.
